id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|365e: "Now then, once the fighting ends, my real work begins!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3666: "I'll take care of all the wounded soldiers, so tonight looks busy!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3675: "I pray the darkness over the sky clears and days of everyone living with smiles return as soon as possible...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3685: "Hehe. If you want a date with me, heal your wounds as soon as you can.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3693: "I was praying that the Luminary's and Hendrik's journey to save the world succeeds.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|369f: "You are our heroes. Please come back safely.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36ab: "Oh, Luminary. I'm honored you spoke to me. Please make yourself at home.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36b8: "I can't find the kitty I was secretly keeping in the castle. I hope she isn't lost...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36c5: "I can't find the kitty I was secretly keeping in the castle. I hope she isn't lost...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36d4: "Good morning, Luminary. That we can greet such a peaceful morning is thanks to you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36e1: "The sky suddenly turned an eerie color. I've never seen this in my life. I have a bad feeling...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36f0: "I can't imagine how hard a journey you've been on, Luminary... Please don't push yourself.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3713: "Welcome, Luminary. We Heliodor people welcome you wholeheartedly.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3721: "Nobody's ever said that to me before... My... my feelings are...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|372e: "...I'm glad of your feelings. But the time when we can live in peace seems far off.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3739: "...Please wait for my reply to your proposal until peace comes.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3746: "Good morning, {var:1}. I never thought I'd see such a refreshing morning.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3751: "For saving the kingdom from monsters, we Heliodor people can never thank you enough.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3761: "Oh... Luminary? I thought you headed to the throne room. Why are you in a place like this...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3771: "Jade's room is always kept perfect so she can relax anytime.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3779: "She traveled for sixteen years, so I'd like her to come rest whenever it's hard.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37a3: "For the throne room, go up these stairs and straight ahead.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37af: "Nom nom... Food this good, I'll never eat again in my lifetime...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37cc: "Nom nom... Food this good, I'll never eat again in my lifetime...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37ba: "Guarding the Cobblestone folk got me this feast. I'll eat it all so I have no regrets...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37d6: "Guarding the Cobblestone folk got me this feast. I'll eat it all so I have no regrets...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37e8: "So many people met the King of Heliodor, so why did nobody think anything was off?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37f4: "To think I obeyed orders for sixteen years not knowing it was a monster. I'm ashamed of myself...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3805: "It's noisy near the balcony... The monster possessing the king was defeated, so what happened now...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3819: "I hear the Luminary's star fell... Even I, who doesn't believe in myths, know it's serious.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3827: "That Luminary's star was a symbol of hope for all who live in Erdrea. To fall in a single night...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3851: "Oh, Luminary {var:1}! The castle soldiers are all surprised, but I always thought something was off.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|385b: "Someone with eyes as pure as yours being a devil's child cursing this land... I could never believe it.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|386e: "I... I've thought you were wonderful for a long time... As a soldier I couldn't say so...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|387a: "Soon it'll be an age where everyone lives in peace. On that day, please... marry... me...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3889: "...A suspicious person appeared, but guard duty is no matter now! Give me your answer to my proposal!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|389b: "The sixteen years the king was controlled by a monster must have been far too long for us and for you...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|38a9: "Luminary, thank you for defeating it. We'll atone for the sixteen years we spent as a monster's pawns...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|38bb: "Am I imagining it? When the sky turned eerie just now, the air trembled with a crackle.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|38cb: "A star I'd watched since childhood falling in one night... Things like this truly happen.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|38d7: "I'm not especially devout, but seeing such overwhelming power, I understand why people want to believe in a god.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|390f: "When Dundrasil fell sixteen years ago, we thought Princess Jade was killed by monsters too...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|391e: "And now Jade has been found safe. Such miracles truly happen...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|392e: "Wow! What a wonderful act! I never dreamed I'd have such a fun time in the castle!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|393f: "Oh, Luminary. Everyone's looking toward the throne room. What happened?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|394a: "I'd stepped away, so I don't know. Could a thief have slipped in during the banquet...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|395a: "A Luminary, a prince, and strong too... I'm envious. Whoever marries you will be happy.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|396d: "A soldier on outer patrol came back flustered a moment ago.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3976: "He muttered 'the star, the star...' What did that soldier see...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3985: "Since ancient times the red star has been revered as the Luminary's star, but its origin isn't clear.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3992: "Whether its fall means good or ill... I hope it's something good.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39c9: "The King of Heliodor changed a lot after Dundrasil fell sixteen years ago, but he lost his daughter.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39da: "I hope Jade's return to the castle heals a little of the king's heart, lonely for sixteen years...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39ec: "Oh, Luminary! That wonderful entertainer is your companion, they say!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39f6: "Only an entertainer this sharp could be the Luminary's companion.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a03: "Honey, you're so dense. Thieves wouldn't break in where there are this many soldiers.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a13: "You lost Dundrasil sixteen years ago, then your village was destroyed... You must have suffered terribly.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a24: "And still you saved Heliodor, which captured you. How merciful you are...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a34: "I heard a flustered soldier say 'the Luminary's star'... What about the Luminary's star?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a46: "I missed the moment the Luminary's star fell, so I don't believe what everyone says.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a53: "Something floating at the edge of the sky suddenly falling... that can't be.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a75: "I can't let you pass. I'm sorry, please refrain.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b0c: "I can't let you pass. I'm sorry, please refrain.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a85: "Hey! You there! I want to patrol the town! Wake up and move!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a91: "...Oh, Luminary. Forgive my unsightly display. It's late, so please rest.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ab1: "Hey, you! You slept in front of the door and play dumb now? Pay the fine for obstructing passage!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3acc: "What's wrong, Luminary? The king went to the third-floor balcony. Please go see!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3adc: "Oh, Luminary. Criminals are held beyond here, so please refrain from entering.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b18: "Oh, Luminary. Criminals are held beyond here, so please refrain from entering.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b26: "Oh, Luminary. Criminals are held beyond here, so please refrain from entering.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3aea: "Going to the basement? Criminals are held beyond here, so please be careful.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b40: "For the balcony, go up the stairs from the corridor just outside the throne room! Hurry, Luminary!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b52: "Still, why did that monster quietly pretend to be the king for sixteen years...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b5c: "Sixteen years... isn't that about your age, Luminary? Could they be related...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b9d: "I, a noble who never lifted anything heavier than a wine glass, why must I do farm work!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ba8: "I'll pay all the gold you want, so someone take the hoe in my place! I'm sick of farming!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bb6: "I'm a noble! A noble person like me doesn't join fights!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bc5: "I'm a noble! A noble person like me doesn't join fights!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bcf: "...What? The fighting's over? Lies! Lies! I won't be fooled!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bd9: "I've only made money till now, but learned gold can't buy life. Being alive is what matters most.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3beb: "I finally got a meeting with the king, then was kicked out again for an important guest.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bf8: "Who is it that meets the king ahead of me? Not once, but twice... grumble grumble...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c09: "Ugh... what a plain room... They said it was a banquet so I came, and this is how a noble is treated...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c28: "Ugh... what a plain room... They said it was a banquet so I came, and this is how a noble is treated...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c16: "I hear the Cobblestone folk are getting a grand welcome in the noble dining hall. What's their tie to the king...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c35: "I hear the Cobblestone folk are getting a grand welcome in the noble dining hall. What's their tie to the king...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c48: "Oh, Luminary, I heard. You defeated the monster that possessed the king for sixteen years.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c57: "That explains everything. The true king would never turn away a renowned noble like me!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c68: "The soldiers keep eyeing the sky. Is a storm coming? With a castle this grand, it should be fine.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c7b: "The Luminary's star was a very large star. If a town lay where it fell, it would be serious.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c88: "The Luminary's symbol falling is a shock, but first we must confirm where it fell and assess the damage...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cb2: "We're noble, you know! We forgave the earlier rudeness and came, but when will we see the king!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cc6: "I hear {var:1} is the prince who survived Dundrasil's fall sixteen years ago.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ce4: "I hear {var:1} is the prince who survived Dundrasil's fall sixteen years ago.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cd2: "When you rebuild the kingdom, let us know. Anyone would gladly help for you, Luminary {var:1}.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cf0: "When you rebuild the kingdom, let us know. Anyone would gladly help for you, Luminary {var:1}.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d03: "The Luminary is on another level. Even at such a lavish banquet, you never let your guard down.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d13: "And you saw through in one night what nobody noticed in sixteen years. As expected of one born a Luminary.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d26: "The soldiers are worried about the sky. Surely thunder isn't coming...? I can't stand thunder!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d35: "Everyone's fussing about the Luminary's star, but I don't know stars well, so I don't know what it is.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d60: "Goodness, the castle's noisy. I meant to nap, but it's too loud to sleep.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d6e: "I thought serving a rich man like me this meal was an insult... but it's not bad once you taste it.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d7c: "I thought serving a rich man like me this meal was an insult... but it's not bad once you taste it.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d8d: "If you hadn't defeated the evil monster possessing the king, Heliodor would have been destroyed.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d9a: "That I'm alive is thanks to you, Luminary. Bless you, bless you...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3da8: "I thought the Luminary's task was done and peace would follow, but something else has happened...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3dc7: "I thought the Luminary's task was done and peace would follow, but something else has happened...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3db6: "Heliodor seems to be a place with many ties to you. Perhaps it's the gods' will.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3dd5: "Heliodor seems to be a place with many ties to you. Perhaps it's the gods' will.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3dfc: "The castle seems noisy. Are you the cause? What's about to begin...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e0d: "That girl named Gemma has been waiting for a boy who went on a journey.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e18: "Whoever he is, leaving such a cute girl behind is a sinful man.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e27: "When the commotion came from the guest room, that entertainer ran off. What happened...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e34: "Still, a first-rate entertainer. Even his running moves were sharp.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e44: "This morning I was looking at the trees in the castle garden, and the leaves seemed to whisper 'thank you'.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e51: "As if each leaf was thanking the Luminary. Was it my imagination...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e60: "What is this ominous air... What is about to happen...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e6c: "The trees are frightened. Whether I feed or water them, they won't perk up.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e97: "As soon as the king returned from outside, he suddenly announced a grand banquet praising the Luminary...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ea6: "Isn't the Luminary a devil's child who brings calamity? The king's change of heart baffles me.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3eb5: "Hey, this is bad, isn't it? If the king sees this, you could be quartered and have no complaint!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ec5: "The current King of Heliodor is real and the previous one was a fake. The fake was a monster, huh.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ed3: "I understand it in theory, but being fooled for sixteen years will take time to accept.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ee1: "One trouble leaves and another comes. A peaceful world doesn't come easily, does it...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ef1: "One trouble leaves and another comes. A peaceful world doesn't come easily, does it...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f08: "Since you came to the castle, a strange tension seems to cover it. Hmm, maybe my imagination.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f16: "The whole castle seems wrapped in strange tension. Hmm, maybe my imagination.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f24: "Ugh... I've always wanted to sit on the throne once, but if the king found out I'd be done for.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f33: "You are the true Luminary. Now that you defeated the monster possessing the king, no one denies you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f45: "Something about a balcony and the Luminary's star. The soldiers are buzzing. What happened now...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f55: "The Luminary's star falling... how terrifying. Is this world cursed?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f7c: "This is the king's room. Please refrain from entering.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f88: "Wh-what is this dog?! I'm afraid of dogs! Go away! Shoo, shoo!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f95: "The king has vanished... I looked in the room and it was empty...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f9f: "Ah, where did the king go...?! Thinking something happened to him, I can't stay calm.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3fb0: "When the king was carried into this room, he was so weak his life was in danger...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3fbd: "Thanks to Jade's devoted care, he recovered enough to walk on his own. Is this the work of family bonds?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3fd0: "The King of Heliodor ran to the balcony. What on earth happened...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3fdf: "The King of Heliodor hasn't fully recovered, yet rests so little, which worries me.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3fea: "Is he trying his best to atone for sixteen years under a monster's control? It hurts to watch.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4016: "My duty is to guard Heliodor Castle so no danger reaches the king. Leave the castle's safety to me.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4025: "While you're with the king, not even an ant will get in.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4032: "Oh, you have business with the king? Sorry, the king has been shut in his room.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|403c: "The king's room is across from Princess Jade's... but he said to let no one through now.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|404e: "Oh, Luminary, you came. Please open this door...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4058: "I don't know when or who got in, but I sense murderous intent beyond it. Who is beyond that door...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|406c: "My duty is to guard Heliodor Castle so no danger reaches the king. I'll protect the king.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|407b: "Oh, Luminary! While you're with the king, I won't let even a bug pass!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|408a: "General Hendrik passed here with the king just now, looking quite flustered.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4095: "There's only a balcony beyond here... What could be wrong?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|40a0: "Heliodor has regained peace, but the precious time the mage Mordegon stole can never be returned.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|40af: "Luminary, Princess Jade... and Rab, and our king... how deep their heart's pain must be.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|40d8: "This is Princess Jade's room. Even the Luminary can't enter. Please refrain.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4124: "This is Princess Jade's room. Even the Luminary can't enter. Please refrain.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|40ea: "That dog has been barking at the king's room all this time. It's deafening.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|40f4: "It's a free-for-all tonight, but I'm nervous the dog's noise will wake the king.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4104: "That big dog... after prowling in front of the king's room, it suddenly ran to the throne room.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4113: "I can't abandon my duty guarding Princess Jade's room, but I wonder what happened...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4134: "Just when I thought peace had come, the ominous sky has everyone frightened...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4141: "This is Princess Jade's room. She told me the Luminary may enter.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4186: "...No, calling you that was our foolish mistake. Please forgive our many rudenesses, Luminary.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4193: "The owner of this tent is a noble person who has been ill since the day the great tree fell.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|41b0: "The owner of this tent is a noble person who has been ill since the day the great tree fell.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|41a2: "I'm terribly sorry, but even the Luminary cannot pass.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|41bf: "I'm terribly sorry, but even the Luminary cannot pass.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|41ce: "We've been waiting, Luminary. This is the King of Heliodor's tent.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|41d5: "The king woke a moment ago, and when he heard you'd returned, he said he wants to see you at once.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|41e7: "My sister is in the hero's unit. She's smitten with him and became a warrior against my objections.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|41f6: "...Oops. Don't tell my sister what I said. We promised it's a secret between us.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4219: "Oops... My duty is to guard the king.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4221: "Talking about family before battle is a sign of weakness. Oops... oops.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4230: "Ritaliphon is Heliodor's finest horse. But proud and fussy, only General Hendrik can ride it.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|423d: "Galloping through countless battlefields with the general, it's a jet-black bullet, so beautiful.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4250: "So monsters don't notice, we've forbidden the bastion's people from seeing you off.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|426b: "So monsters don't notice, we've forbidden the bastion's people from seeing you off.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4286: "So monsters don't notice, we've forbidden the bastion's people from seeing you off.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42a5: "The King of Heliodor and Chief Dan talked, and the Last Bastion's future was decided.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42b3: "On condition of helping rebuild Cobblestone, we Heliodor folk may stay in this village a while longer.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42c1: "And the Cobblestone folk promised to help rebuild Heliodor...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42cd: "We lost much, but gained irreplaceable friends. We'll surely move forward.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42e0: "...Luminary. All your harsh days of adventure were preparation for this moment.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42eb: "Nothing can now block your path to slay the Dark One. Your comeback starts here.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42f7: "You are our hope, the Luminary. Please restore peace to Erdrea.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4305: "Princess Jade's lively figure is the spitting image of the young King of Heliodor! Our future is bright!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4315: "The King of Heliodor is waiting. Please, to the throne room!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4320: "Ugh... when my partner drinks, he can't tell what's all right to say...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|432c: "If the king heard this talk, we'd all be beheaded... Please keep it secret.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4349: "The king went to the third-floor balcony. Please go with him and see outside, Luminary!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|435b: "While General Hendrik travels with the Luminary, we'll protect Heliodor Castle with our lives.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4369: "...Strange. I feel I've seen General Hendrik off like this before, going on a journey with the Luminary.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4392: "Oh, Luminary, you came. I was terribly rude earlier. Please go to the king!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43a3: "Not to be rude, but the king hosting a banquet for someone surprised me.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43ae: "On the queen's death anniversary, he doesn't even lay a flower at her grave. That kind of man.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43bf: "The king doesn't appear, noise comes from the Luminary's bedroom, and the dog is barking as you see...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43cc: "Even for a banquet, the castle's state is surely abnormal...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43e4: "For the balcony, climb the stairs on this floor and follow the corridor. Hurry, Luminary!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43f8: "The monster possessing the king took sixteen years from far too many people.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4404: "If true peace comes, I hope the King of Heliodor and Princess Jade regain their lost happiness.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4413: "And... I wish I could share peace with General Jasper too...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4437: "You were the true Luminary. We were blind to that for so long.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4443: "Having learned the truth, the king changed his mind. Please go to the throne room and hear him out.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4455: "The throne room's noisy... Even if the king said free-for-all, overdoing it could get you beheaded...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4468: "What on earth is happening? Beyond the door I hear an inhuman, terrifying growl...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4474: "At times like this, we soldiers should look, but my body is frozen and can't move...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4486: "Long live the great Luminary! Salute Luminary {var:1}!!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4492: "Since ancient times, something happening to a star has foretold history stirring.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|449c: "I only pray the Luminary's star's anomaly is not an omen of disaster...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|44aa: "Oh... {var:1}. Since I heard the Luminary's star fell, I've had a bad feeling.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|44b6: "A star falling is no small matter. Please, {var:1}, find out the truth.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4538: "Oh, a visitor is rare. This is the prison for criminals. If you want a prisoner, speak through the bars.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4561: "...Oh, Luminary. With the Cobblestone folk freed, these cells are nearly empty.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4575: "I sense an unsettling air from the throne room. If you go there, you might pray just in case.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|45c7: "Outside the bastion is full of terrible monsters. If you need strong weapons, shop at my store.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|45db: "Shopping for weapons just as monsters may attack, I like your composure! Buy whatever! Well then...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|45f3: "I hear you'll fight for the bastion. All I can do is prepare the best weapons and armor for you...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|46a7: "Behind this tent there's a pier on the river, and a girl there catches my eye.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|46b0: "She seems to have no family. She sits alone on the pier staring at the river all day.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|46bd: "Something painful must have happened. I'm working and can't keep her company, so please talk to her.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|46d1: "There was a girl with no family on the pier behind this tent, but I haven't seen her lately.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|46de: "I don't know where she went, but I hope she's doing well...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|46ec: "As a cook I don't need spears or swords! Monsters, come at me from anywhere! I'll make you a delicious meunière!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|47b9: "...No. Let's stop calling you that. Luminary {var:1} is fitting.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|47c2: "I'm sorry for what we did. Everyone believed the Luminary was the one harming this land... forgive us.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|47d3: "I'm sorry for what we did. Everyone believed the Luminary was the one harming this land... forgive us.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|47e5: "I watched the battle at Gondolia, so I know your strength well. But don't be careless.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|47f1: "The monsters attacking this bastion are tough, like well-trained soldiers. Let your guard down and you'll fall.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4803: "{var:1}, General Hendrik has returned to the bastion ahead of you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4809: "The King of Heliodor is waiting for you. Leave the rest to us and head to the king's tent.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4819: "Tonight the sky is quieter than ever. You can reach Heliodor Castle without the monsters noticing.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4825: "I pray for the operation's success. Beware strong monsters on the way.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4879: "When a huge explosion happened and I was crying alone, Cole spoke to me.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4882: "Thinking I'm not alone anymore gave me courage, and I could flee to the Last Bastion.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|488e: "Since then Cole plays with me and the bastion folk are kind. I'm glad I didn't give up.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|48a0: "The hero is coming back, so Cole is going to welcome him.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|48a7: "He invited me but I'm not interested in heroes. Really, really not interested!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|48b6: "If monsters attack, will we all die?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|48bd: "...Why say such scary things? That's mean, big brother...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|48c6: "If I die, what happens to me? Can't I play with Cole and Draco anymore? I don't want that...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|48d6: "Cole kept saying that {var:1} is so strong he'll crush monsters!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|48df: "So I got courage bubbling up and wasn't scared at all while hiding!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|48f2: "Hehe. The monsters are gone, but Cole promised to keep protecting me.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|48fd: "There was lots of painful stuff, but I'm so glad I came to this village.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c60: "Princess Jade, missing so long, has returned to the castle. How happy.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c6b: "And they say the one who brought her back was a vicious criminal who escaped the dungeon. He's reformed splendidly.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c89: "I don't want children with futures to stray the same way, so I make night rounds.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d29: "The day the great tree fell, I hurt my back badly. I may not dance like before.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d36: "Hehe... but it's fine. I may not look it, but I'm second-best at sewing after dancing.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d40: "My late grandma taught me from scratch for when I marry.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d4d: "Chief Dan told me. You're Gemma's sweetheart, right?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d58: "Then don't waste time here. Cheer Gemma up.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d60: "She's strong so she won't say it, but at times like this any girl wants her loved one near.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d72: "...Oh, is that so. She only talks about you, so I thought you two were close.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d81: "I'm treating wounded soldiers now. Gemma should be nearby, so show her your healthy face.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d92: "...What am I applying, you ask? Hehe. It's a secret for now.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e7b: "This used to be the chief's house. Move the rubble a bit and there may be some treasure. Heh heh.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e89: "Whoa, you're persistent, kid. Don't bother me while I work. Scram.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e97: "I'm not joining a monster fight! I won't risk my precious life for this!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4ea3: "So I'm hiding here. Got it? Get lost! Shoo, shoo!!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4ead: "My great efforts protected the bastion's peace! Be grateful, hee hee!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4ec2: "A place called Angri-La on the summit of Mount Pang Lai is said to be home to many priests.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4ece: "For a bad guy like me, it must be hell. Oooh, scary.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|50b5: "The world's buzzing about the Luminary's star, but nobody here cares. We're too poor for that.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|513d: "Did you know? They say a lavish banquet was held at the castle for the Luminary.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5149: "The king was the Luminary's mortal enemy until recently... What's got into him?

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|519c: "The king is stingy. If such a happy banquet was held, they should invite the lower folk too.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|51e3: "Right. Even if today's bad, tomorrow may bring good. For now, let's look forward to tomorrow's me.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5402: "The Luminary's amazing! Jailed for serious crimes, yet now the king treats him as a hero.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5410: "Did he bribe the king with gold? Or use an even shadier trick? Either way, he's a real rogue!

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5928: "If the Luminary's star fell, the world must be nearing its end, right? Then I want no regrets.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5b76: "Does that mean a party? I don't know the occasion, but a celebration is a treat after so long.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5b84: "It can't compare to the castle banquet, but I tried hard to make my husband's favorite dish.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5c6a: "If told the truth now they'd panic and cause an uproar. Please proceed quietly into the castle.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5ca9: "The queen who died long ago was reportedly very beautiful, so the princess must be lovely too.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5cb9: "I thought I heard a scream from the castle earlier. Must be my imagination.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5df9: "He never shows sorrow. Perhaps he hides his feelings so as not to worry the people.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5e0c: "Thanks to the Luminary, peace in Heliodor was kept, but the monsters' threat hasn't lessened.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5e19: "I don't know the details, but true peace still takes time, doesn't it...?

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5e4e: "Oh, I see. General Hendrik and the King of Heliodor... a rare thing indeed.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5e5c: "I'm a townsman, but a soldier dragged me here to keep the villagers company.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5e6a: "But I've never eaten anything this tasty in my life. Living long has its rewards.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5e77: "The wind's strangely restless. I've lived in this town long, but never had such an uneasy night.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5e87: "The wind's strangely restless. I've lived in this town long, but never had such an uneasy night.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5e99: "Oh, Luminary... I heard from the soldiers that your symbol fell.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5eb6: "Oh, Luminary... I heard from the soldiers that your symbol fell.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5ea4: "Even if the star fell, nothing happens to you, Luminary, but please take care of yourself.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5f70: "The Luminary's star falling... what's happening? I hope nothing ominous occurs.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5fec: "Soldiers are guarding more strictly than usual, and the town feels tense.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5ff7: "I don't know what's starting, but maybe a king is visiting the castle...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6005: "The castle's banquet seems to be lively. Tch, I should've become a soldier.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6013: "I hear the castle is in an uproar over the Luminary's star falling, but I can't see well from here.

tm.「さてと 戦いが終わってからが\n 私の お仕事の本番なのですよ！: "Now then, once the fighting ends, my real work begins!
tm.「ケガをした 兵士さんたちは\n みんな 私が面倒を見ますから\n 今夜は 忙し: "I'll take care of all the wounded soldiers, so tonight looks busy!
tm.「どうか 空をおおう 闇が晴れ\n 皆が 笑顔で暮らせる日々が\n １日でも 早: "I pray the darkness over the sky clears and days of everyone living with smiles return as soon as possible...
tm.「うふふ。私と デートしたかったら\n あなたは １日でも早く\n おケガを治し: "Hehe. If you want a date with me, heal your wounds as soon as you can.
tm.「勇者さまと グレイグさまの\n 世界を救う旅が 無事に成功するように\n お祈: "I was praying that the Luminary's and Hendrik's journey to save the world succeeds.
tm.「あなた方は 私たちの英雄よ。\n どうか 無事に 戻ってきてくださいね。: "You are our heroes. Please come back safely.
tm.「まあ 勇者さま。\n 話しかけてくださるなんて 光栄ですわ。\n どうぞ ゆっ: "Oh, Luminary. I'm honored you spoke to me. Please make yourself at home.
tm.「お城の中で こっそり飼っていた\n ネコちゃんが 見つからないんです。\n 迷: "I can't find the kitty I was secretly keeping in the castle. I hope she isn't lost...
tm.「おはようございます 勇者さま。\n こうして おだやかな朝が迎えられるのも\n: "Good morning, Luminary. That we can greet such a peaceful morning is thanks to you.
tm.「突然 空が不気味な色になりましたけど\n こんなの 生まれてはじめてですわ。\: "The sky suddenly turned an eerie color. I've never seen this in my life. I have a bad feeling...
tm.「勇者さまが どれほど 大変な旅をされているか\n 私には 想像も およびません: "I can't imagine how hard a journey you've been on, Luminary... Please don't push yourself.
tm.「ようこそ 勇者さま。\n 私たち デルカダールの民は\n あなたさまを 心より: "Welcome, Luminary. We Heliodor people welcome you wholeheartedly.
tm.「そんなこと はじめて言われましたわ……。\n 私の……私の気持ちは……。: "Nobody's ever said that to me before... My... my feelings are...
tm.「……あなたの気持ちは うれしいです。\n しかし 安心して暮らせるような時代は: "...I'm glad of your feelings. But the time when we can live in peace seems far off.
tm.「……平和な世が 訪れるまで\n プロポーズの返事は お待ちくださいませ。: "...Please wait for my reply to your proposal until peace comes.
tm.「おはようございます {var:1}さま。\n こんなに すがすがしい朝を\n: "Good morning, {var:1}. I never thought I'd see such a refreshing morning.
tm.「魔物から 王国を救っていただいて\n 私たち デルカダールの民は\n どれだけ: "For saving the kingdom from monsters, we Heliodor people can never thank you enough.
tm.「あら……勇者さま？\n 玉座の間へ 向かわれたと思ってましたが\n なぜ この: "Oh... Luminary? I thought you headed to the throne room. Why are you in a place like this...?
tm.「マルティナさまの お部屋は\n いつでも くつろいでいただけるように\n 常に: "Jade's room is always kept perfect so she can relax anytime.
tm.「１６年間も 旅をしていらしたのですから\n おつらい時は いつでも\n 休みに: "She traveled for sixteen years, so I'd like her to come rest whenever it's hard.
tm.「玉座の間へは こちらの階段を上がり\n まっすぐ お進みください。: "For the throne room, go up these stairs and straight ahead.
tm.「ハフハフ……ホフホフ……。\n こんなにウマいものは 一生の間に\n もう 二: "Nom nom... Food this good, I'll never eat again in my lifetime...
tm.「イシの村の連中の 警護についていたおかげで\n こんな ごちそうにありつけると: "Guarding the Cobblestone folk got me this feast. I'll eat it all so I have no regrets...
tm.「今まで たくさんの人が デルカダール王に\n 会ってきたというのに どうして\: "So many people met the King of Heliodor, so why did nobody think anything was off?
tm.「１６年もの間 魔物が相手とも知らず\n 命令に したがっていたのかと思うと\n: "To think I obeyed orders for sixteen years not knowing it was a monster. I'm ashamed of myself...
tm.「バルコニーの辺りが 騒がしいですね……。\n 王に取り憑いていた魔物は 倒され: "It's noisy near the balcony... The monster possessing the king was defeated, so what happened now...?
tm.「勇者の星が 落ちてしまったそうですね……。\n 神話を信じない 私にとっても\: "I hear the Luminary's star fell... Even I, who doesn't believe in myths, know it's serious.
tm.「あの勇者の星は ロトゼタシアを生きる\n すべての者にとって 希望の象徴でした: "That Luminary's star was a symbol of hope for all who live in Erdrea. To fall in a single night...
tm.「おお {var:1}さま！\n 城内の兵士は 皆 おどろいていますが\n 私は: "Oh, Luminary {var:1}! The castle soldiers are all surprised, but I always thought something was off.
tm.「あなたさまのような 清らかな目をした方が\n この地にあだなす 悪魔の子など…: "Someone with eyes as pure as yours being a devil's child cursing this land... I could never believe it.
tm.「わ……私は ずっと前から きみを\n ステキな子だと思っていた……。\n 兵士: "I... I've thought you were wonderful for a long time... As a soldier I couldn't say so...
tm.「もうじき 皆が 安心して暮らせる時代になる。\n その日には どうか……\n: "Soon it'll be an age where everyone lives in peace. On that day, please... marry... me...
tm.「……なにやら 不審者が出たようだが\n 今は 警備の仕事など どうでもいい！\: "...A suspicious person appeared, but guard duty is no matter now! Give me your answer to my proposal!
tm.「王が 魔物に支配されてきた １６年間は\n 我々にとっても あなたにとっても\: "The sixteen years the king was controlled by a monster must have been far too long for us and for you...
tm.「勇者さま よくぞ ヤツを倒してくれました。\n これから我々は 魔物の手先とし: "Luminary, thank you for defeating it. We'll atone for the sixteen years we spent as a monster's pawns...
tm.「気のせいでしょうか……？\n 先ほど 空が不気味な色になった時に\n ビリッと: "Am I imagining it? When the sky turned eerie just now, the air trembled with a crackle.
tm.「子供の頃から ながめていた星が\n 一夜にして 落ちてしまうなんて……。\n: "A star I'd watched since childhood falling in one night... Things like this truly happen.
tm.「私は 特に 信心深いわけではありませんが\n あんな ケタはずれのチカラを見た: "I'm not especially devout, but seeing such overwhelming power, I understand why people want to believe in a god.
tm.「１６年前 ユグノア王国が滅びた時に\n 王女のマルティナさまも 魔物に襲われて: "When Dundrasil fell sixteen years ago, we thought Princess Jade was killed by monsters too...
tm.「なんと 今になって マルティナさまが\n ご無事な姿で見つかったそうだ。\n: "And now Jade has been found safe. Such miracles truly happen...
tm.「うほほ～っ！ なんと すばらしい芸だ！\n お城の中で こんな楽しい時が過ごせ: "Wow! What a wonderful act! I never dreamed I'd have such a fun time in the castle!
tm.「おや 勇者さま。\n みんな 玉座の間の方を見ていますが\n はて 何が あっ: "Oh, Luminary. Everyone's looking toward the throne room. What happened?
tm.「私は席を外していたので 存じませんが\n もしや 宴に乗じて\n 泥棒でも 入: "I'd stepped away, so I don't know. Could a thief have slipped in during the banquet...?
tm.「勇者さまで 王子さまで 強いなんて……。\n いやはや うらやましい限りです。: "A Luminary, a prince, and strong too... I'm envious. Whoever marries you will be happy.
tm.「さっき 外回りに出ていた兵士が\n あわてた様子で 戻ってきましてね。: "A soldier on outer patrol came back flustered a moment ago.
tm.「星が 星が……と つぶやいていましたが\n あの兵士さんは いったい\n 何を: "He muttered 'the star, the star...' What did that soldier see...?
tm.「いにしえの時代より 赤い星は\n 勇者の星として 崇められてきましたが\n じ: "Since ancient times the red star has been revered as the Luminary's star, but its origin isn't clear.
tm.「その 勇者の星が落ちてしまったことが\n 吉と出るか 凶と出るか……。\n よ: "Whether its fall means good or ill... I hope it's something good.
tm.「１６年前 ユグノア王国が滅ぼされてから\n デルカダール王は ずいぶん性格が変: "The King of Heliodor changed a lot after Dundrasil fell sixteen years ago, but he lost his daughter.
tm.「マルティナさまが お城に戻られることで\n １６年間 ひとりぼっちだった王さま: "I hope Jade's return to the castle heals a little of the king's heart, lonely for sixteen years...
tm.「まあ 勇者さま！\n こちらの ステキな旅芸人さんは\n 勇者さまの お仲間だ: "Oh, Luminary! That wonderful entertainer is your companion, they say!
tm.「やはり これくらい キレのある旅芸人でないと\n 勇者さまの仲間は つとまらな: "Only an entertainer this sharp could be the Luminary's companion.
tm.「あなたったら カンが悪いわね。\n 兵士が こんなに いっぱいいる場所に\n: "Honey, you're so dense. Thieves wouldn't break in where there are this many soldiers.
tm.「勇者さまは １６年前に ユグノア王国を失い\n 暮らしていた イシの村を滅ぼさ: "You lost Dundrasil sixteen years ago, then your village was destroyed... You must have suffered terribly.
tm.「それなのに 勇者さまを捕らえた\n デルカダール王国を 救ってくださるなんて\: "And still you saved Heliodor, which captured you. How merciful you are...
tm.「あわてた様子の 兵士さんから\n 勇者の星……という言葉が聞こえましたが\n: "I heard a flustered soldier say 'the Luminary's star'... What about the Luminary's star?
tm.「私 勇者の星が 落ちる瞬間を\n 見逃がしてしまって……。\n ですから みん: "I missed the moment the Luminary's star fell, so I don't believe what everyone says.
tm.「だって……空の果てに 浮いているものが\n 突然 落ちてくるなんて……。\n: "Something floating at the edge of the sky suddenly falling... that can't be.
tm.「この先へは お通しできません。\n 申し訳ありませんが ご遠慮ください。: "I can't let you pass. I'm sorry, please refrain.
tm.「おいっ！ そこのお前！\n 私は 城下町の見回りに 行きたいんだ！\n さっさ: "Hey! You there! I want to patrol the town! Wake up and move!
tm.「……おお 勇者さま。\n お見苦しいところを お見せしました。\n 遅い時間で: "...Oh, Luminary. Forgive my unsightly display. It's late, so please rest.
tm.「おいっ キサマ！ さんざん扉の前で寝ておいて\n 知らばっくれようたって そう: "Hey, you! You slept in front of the door and play dumb now? Pay the fine for obstructing passage!
tm.「どうされました 勇者さま？\n 王は ３階のバルコニーへ向かわれました。\n: "What's wrong, Luminary? The king went to the third-floor balcony. Please go see!
tm.「おや 勇者さま。\n ここから先は 罪人が捕らわれておりますから\n 立ち入り: "Oh, Luminary. Criminals are held beyond here, so please refrain from entering.
tm.「おや 地下に行かれるのですか？\n この先は 罪人が 捕らわれていますので\n: "Going to the basement? Criminals are held beyond here, so please be careful.
tm.「バルコニーへは 玉座の間から出てすぐの\n 通路から階段を上がると 行けます！: "For the balcony, go up the stairs from the corridor just outside the throne room! Hurry, Luminary!
tm.「それにしても あの魔物は\n なぜ １６年間も おとなしく\n 王さまに なり: "Still, why did that monster quietly pretend to be the king for sixteen years...?
tm.「１６年といえば 勇者さまも\n ちょうど それくらいの ご年齢ですよね？\n: "Sixteen years... isn't that about your age, Luminary? Could they be related...?
tm.「ワイングラスより 重たいものを\n 持ったことのなかった 貴族のわしが\n な: "I, a noble who never lifted anything heavier than a wine glass, why must I do farm work!
tm.「金なら 好きなだけやるから\n わしの代わりに 誰かクワを持て！\n もう 農: "I'll pay all the gold you want, so someone take the hoe in my place! I'm sick of farming!
tm.「わしは 貴族なのじゃ！\n 高貴な人間である わしは\n 戦いになど 参加せぬ: "I'm a noble! A noble person like me doesn't join fights!
tm.「……え？ 戦いは もう終わった？\n ウソじゃ！ ウソじゃ！\n わしは だま: "...What? The fighting's over? Lies! Lies! I won't be fooled!
tm.「わしは 今まで 金もうけばかりしてきたが\n 金があっても 命は買えんとわかっ: "I've only made money till now, but learned gold can't buy life. Being alive is what matters most.
tm.「ようやく デルカダール王に会えるということで\n 取りついでもらったのに 大事: "I finally got a meeting with the king, then was kicked out again for an important guest.
tm.「まったく……わしを後まわしにしてまで\n 王に会えるとは どこの誰じゃ？\n: "Who is it that meets the king ahead of me? Not once, but twice... grumble grumble...
